title: The install stopped partway
body: The install did not run through (the phone answered FAIL to 'flash:dtbo_b': injected failure).
If it stops the same way again, tell us at https://github.com/derekross/omarchy-mobile/issues
footer: The install stopped while it was writing slot B's boot images: 4 of 5 were written, and the next one may be partly written.
userdata was not written: what the phone had stored is still there.
Slot A, where Android is, was not written, and it is still the slot the phone starts from.
Bring the phone to Fastboot Mode and start the installer again: it checks the phone again and writes every image again, from the first.
